input: variants.vcf: 11 gnomAD v2.1.1 records on chromosome 21 (public rs identifiers where the release carries one, one record without an identifier; INFO dropped), every position covered by the genome coverage file: five substitutions, intergenic, intronic, upstream and downstream of a gene; three three-base deletions, each averaged over the three records of its deleted bases; three insertions, each reading the record after the insertion point alone while the base before it is covered too. Reference alleles are the records' own.
generator: manifest: scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --release 116 --assembly GRCh37 --suite gnomadc=<reference>=<candidates> --k 100 --max-records 100 --include <each record> --covers gnomADc --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=--dir_plugins --flag={plugins} --flag=--plugin --flag=gnomADc,plugin_data/gnomad.coverage.tsv.gz --cache <cache>, then plugin_files added; json_cache: scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --assembly GRCh37 --cache-version 116 over the chromosome 21 slice converted from the Ensembl VEP 116 GRCh37 cache; expected and this record: scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --format all --dir-plugins <the VEP_plugins checkout at release/116>

plugin_fixtures.description: plugin_data/gnomad.coverage.tsv.gz: a cut of the real coverage file, the records within two bases before and six bases after each input record, so the fixture carries every record a span reads and its neighbours; identical on both sides
plugin_fixtures.source: gnomAD v2.1 genome coverage summary (gnomad.genomes.coverage.summary.tsv.bgz, https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/downloads), prepared as the Ensembl VEP plugin documents: the header prefixed with #, bgzip-compressed and indexed with tabix -s 1 -b 2 -e 2; thirteen columns, contigs named 1 to 22 and X
plugin_fixtures.cut: tabix -H <prepared file>; tabix <prepared file> <regions> | bgzip -c; tabix -s 1 -b 2 -e 2 plugin_data/gnomad.coverage.tsv.gz
